about_short_description.short_description: National Medical Care is a family health care center.

product.name: Hospital Services
product.description: Provision of inpatient and outpatient medical care across multiple hospital branches including emergency, long-term care, and dialysis services.

product.name: Specialized Medical Clinics
product.description: Outpatient clinics providing diagnosis and treatment across various medical specialties such as neurology, cardiology, dermatology, pediatrics, and more.

product.name: Home Care Services
product.description: Medical care and support provided to patients in their homes, including nursing and rehabilitation services.

product.name: Emergency Medical Services
product.description: Specialized emergency care services including a dedicated emergency medical center for urgent health conditions.

product.name: Dialysis Services
product.description: Provision of kidney dialysis treatment for patients with chronic kidney failure at specialized hospital units.
